**Bug-fix release from the lab dry run of 2.0.5: `Install-SoaToolkit.ps1 -Step All -WhatIf` now runs end to end, and dry runs count for L2 again. A new static check prevents this class of defect.**

> The end-to-end lab validation of the 2.x scripts (L1-L20) is in progress ([docs/VALIDATION.md](https://github.com/mayer-bautechnik/cloudsync-soa-toolkit/blob/v2.0.6/docs/VALIDATION.md)). Validate in your own lab first.

## Fixed

Inside a script, `-WhatIf` also reaches the built-in cmdlets. The dry run therefore skipped scratch work it needs itself. A real run (without `-WhatIf`) was not affected, apart from the left-over KIR folder below.

- **`-Step DeployTasks -WhatIf` failed with "Cannot find path ...\soa_stage_*\SoaToolkit.psm1".**
  - Cause: the staging folder in `%TEMP%` and the copies in it were skipped, then `Get-FileHash` read the missing files. With a signing certificate configured, the step would have stopped at "Signing ... failed".
  - Fix: staging runs in the dry run too and is removed in every case. A dry run does not sign (no key use, no timestamp request) and reports SKIP.
- **`-Step KirGpo -WhatIf` stopped with "msiexec /a failed" in PowerShell 7.**
  - Cause: `Start-Process` honours `-WhatIf` in PowerShell 7. In Windows PowerShell 5.1 it has no `-WhatIf`; there the extraction ran, but its `%TEMP%\soa_kir_*` folder stayed behind.
  - Fix: the extraction moved to the module function `Expand-SoaMsi`. The folder is removed in every case, also when a package is skipped in a real run.
- **Dry runs were missing from `Export-SoaReport.ps1` (L2 stayed OPEN).** Since 2.0.2 the run log had no START line for a dry run, because `-WhatIf` skipped it. Install and Uninstall now write their run log in dry runs as well.
- **Verify and Conform wrote no report in a dry run.** The monitor and the read-only analysis inherited `-WhatIf`. They now write their reports; neither changes anything in the domain.

If you have folders `soa_stage_*` or `soa_kir_*` in `%TEMP%` of your admin account, you can delete them.

## New

- **`tools/Test-SoaScriptScope.ps1`** has a third check: scratch files and run logs are not skipped by `-WhatIf`, and scripts with `-WhatIf` contain no `Start-Process`. Run against 2.0.5, it reports the defects above.

## Upgrade from 2.0.5

1. Replace the toolkit files and keep your `SoaToolkit.config.psd1`; there are no new keys.
2. Run `.\Install-SoaToolkit.ps1 -Step All -WhatIf`, then without `-WhatIf`.
   - The dry run now also stages the scripts, extracts the KIR package and writes the run log and the reports. It changes nothing in AD, SYSVOL or on the hosts.
   - The steps that already ran report SAME.
   - DeployTasks puts 2.0.6 on every host.

Details: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/mayer-bautechnik/cloudsync-soa-toolkit/blob/v2.0.6/CHANGELOG.md)

## Verify the download

Compare the SHA-256 of the asset with the digest GitHub shows next to it. The zip contains `SHA256SUMS.txt` for every file:

```powershell
Get-FileHash .\cloudsync-soa-toolkit-2.0.6.zip -Algorithm SHA256
Get-ChildItem -Recurse | Unblock-File
```

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mayer-bautechnik/cloudsync-soa-toolkit/compare/v2.0.5...v2.0.6
